reason: The bill knowingly leaves U1 (pre-copy evidence off-Git; pin only proves existence at pin), U2 (board editable/unavailable), U3 (any main commit voids the candidate; no freeze/queue), and U4 (requester is beneficiary) unresolved, and it expressly weakens Act 21 s2 record timing. These are central audit/ordering defects, not minor residuals. Prefer the Git-native tree+base rule or a freeze/queue.
